textContent.text: Just then, Chipmunk saw his friend Turtle across the river. Turtle was standing under the peach tree.

"I am trying to get a peach," answered Turtle. "But I can't reach high enough to pick one, and I can't climb trees."
"I want a peach, too!" said Chipmunk. "But first I need to get across this river, and I can't swim."
